title: KEDA / Operations
description: Curated health view of KEDA in the homelab: are the operator, the metrics API server and the admission webhooks up and error-free, and (once ScaledObjects exist) are scalers reading their sources. Built from the KEDA 2.21 Prometheus docs (https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/), controller-runtime and Kubernetes apiserver metrics. The official per-ScaledObject dashboard is 'KEDA / Official'.

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What KEDA does here.** KEDA (namespace `keda`, chart 2.21.0) scales workloads from external events
(queues, Prometheus queries, cron…) through `ScaledObject`/`ScaledJob` resources. Three components:
the **operator** (watches ScaledObjects, creates one HPA `keda-hpa-<name>` each, runs the scalers),
the **metrics API server** (serves `external.metrics.k8s.io` to the HPA controller) and the **admission webhooks**
(validate the CRs). **Today no ScaledObject exists**, so the *Scalers* row is empty by design — KEDA only emits
scaler metrics once a scaler is configured.

**Healthy looks like:** all three targets up, version 2.21.0, 0 reconcile errors, no 5xx from the metrics API server or
the webhooks, no certificate read errors (KEDA rotates its own TLS certificates: the `cert-rotator` controller).

**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 -n keda logs deploy/keda-operator` (scaler and reconcile errors),
`kubectl --context k8s01 get apiservice v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io` (must be Available; if not, every HPA that uses
external metrics stops scaling), `kubectl --context k8s01 get scaledobjects -A` (READY/ACTIVE columns).

panels.title: Operator
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the KEDA operator (1 = up). Down = no new HPAs, scalers not polled. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/. Derived query: Prometheus `up` of the scrape job.

panels.title: Metrics API server
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the metrics API server. Down = HPAs using external metrics cannot read them (they keep the current replica count). Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/. Derived query: Prometheus `up` of the scrape job.

panels.title: Admission webhooks
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the admission webhooks. Down = creating/updating ScaledObjects fails (failurePolicy) or skips validation. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/. Derived query: Prometheus `up` of the scrape job.

panels.title: external.metrics API
panels.description: Availability of the APIService v1beta1.external.metrics.k8s.io as seen by kube-apiserver (aggregator_unavailable_apiservice: 0 = available). Unavailable = every HPA that uses external metrics stops scaling; kube-prometheus-stack alerts KubeAggregatedAPIDown/Errors cover it. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: KEDA version from `keda_build_info` (must match the chart pin 2.21.0 in helm-charts/keda/helmfile.yaml.gotmpl). Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: 1 when the operator holds its leader-election lease (`operator.keda.sh`). With one replica it must be 1; 0 means the operator is running but idle. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: KEDA-managed HPAs
panels.description: HorizontalPodAutoscalers created by KEDA (named keda-hpa-<ScaledObject>), from kube-state-metrics. 0 today: no ScaledObject yet. Source: https://github.com/kedacore/keda/blob/v2.21.0/config/grafana/keda-dashboard.json. Derived query: count of kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_info with the keda-hpa- prefix used by the official dashboard.

panels.title: Reconcile errors (24h)
panels.description: Failed reconciliations of KEDA controllers (scaledobject, scaledjob, triggerauthentication, cert-rotator, …) in the last 24 h. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Cert read errors (24h)
panels.description: Errors reading the TLS certificates KEDA generates for itself (operator gRPC, metrics API server, webhooks). Non-zero = broken internal TLS; the HPA controller will fail to reach the metrics API server. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Reconciliations by controller and result
panels.description: Reconcile outcomes per KEDA controller. `error` should stay at 0; `requeue_after` is normal for ScaledObjects (periodic re-check). Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Reconcile errors by controller
panels.description: Errors per controller (scaledobject, scaledjob, triggerauthentication, clustertriggerauthentication, cloudeventsource, cert-rotator). An error usually means an invalid trigger or unreachable TriggerAuthentication secret. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Workqueue depth
panels.description: Objects waiting to be reconciled per controller queue (operator) and the metrics API server's internal certificate controllers. Should be ~0. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/component-base/blob/master/metrics/prometheus/workqueue/metrics.go.

panels.title: Reconcile duration (p95)
panels.description: p95 time of one reconciliation per controller. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference. Derived query: histogram_quantile(0.95) over controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket.

panels.title: Kubernetes API responses by component
panels.description: Requests from the KEDA components to the Kubernetes API by HTTP code. 2xx is normal (the operator PUTs its leader lease and certificate secrets); 4xx/5xx point at RBAC or API server trouble. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/.

panels.title: Metrics API server (what the HPA controller calls)
Requests by code
panels.description: Requests served by the KEDA metrics API server (aggregated API external.metrics.k8s.io, plus discovery/OpenAPI calls from kube-apiserver), by HTTP code. 5xx = HPAs cannot read external metrics. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/; https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Request latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 latency of the metrics API server by verb. The HPA controller polls every 15 s; slow responses delay scaling decisions. Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/. Derived query: histogram_quantile(0.95) over apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket.

panels.title: gRPC calls to the operator
panels.description: Calls from the metrics API server to the operator's internal metrics service, by gRPC code. Empty until a ScaledObject is queried by an HPA (KEDA docs). Non-OK codes = the API server cannot reach the operator. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Webhook requests by code
panels.description: Validation requests per webhook path (scaledobject, scaledjob, triggerauthentication, …) by HTTP code. They only happen when someone applies a KEDA CR. 500 = the webhook crashed while validating. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Rejected ScaledObjects
panels.description: ScaledObject validations that failed (e.g. two ScaledObjects targeting the same workload, or an existing HPA on it). Metric appears after the first validation (KEDA docs). Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Scaler errors
panels.description: Errors returned by each scaler while reading its source (Prometheus query failing, queue unreachable, bad credentials). When a scaler errors KEDA falls back to the `fallback` replicas if configured. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/; https://github.com/kedacore/keda/blob/v2.21.0/config/grafana/keda-dashboard.json.

panels.title: ScaledObject / ScaledJob errors
panels.description: Errors handling each ScaledObject or ScaledJob. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/; https://github.com/kedacore/keda/blob/v2.21.0/config/grafana/keda-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Scaler metric value
panels.description: Current value of each scaler metric — the number the HPA compares with the target. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/; https://github.com/kedacore/keda/blob/v2.21.0/config/grafana/keda-dashboard.json.

panels.title: Scaler latency
panels.description: Time to fetch the metric from each scaler's source. High latency slows the scale loop. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Scale loop lag
panels.description: Deviation between the expected and actual execution time of the scaling loop (KEDA docs: accumulated scaler latency or high load). Seconds here = KEDA reacts late. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Active / paused
panels.description: Scalers currently active (1 = the source says there is work, workload scaled up from zero) and ScaledObjects paused by annotation. Source: https://keda.sh/docs/2.21/integrations/prometheus/.

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory per KEDA container (solid) and its limit (dashed). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used per KEDA container. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.
